verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a large first-party integration catalog (750+ platform integrations, "hundreds of native integrations"), and its Events API ingests events from observability platforms. Of the named tools, only Sentry is specifically evidenced, and only as an SRE Agent log-retrieval connector rather than an alert-ingestion integration. Missing for 10: evidence of first-party Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus and CloudWatch integrations, documented setup guides for any of the named tools, a Sentry alert-ingestion integration, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, first-party integrations cover my observability stack — Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Sentry — with documented setup

citations.quote: With 750+ platform integrations, PagerDuty is a leader in connecting tools, data, and AI to your incident management process.
The platform supports this through hundreds of native integrations
ingests machine events from monitoring tools and other systems like code repositories, observability platforms
the SRE Agent can intelligently deduce the next steps for troubleshooting issues by retrieving log data from Sentry
